reviews.review:
Absolutely adorable and chill game for any dragon lovers out there. I'm a sucker for simple games that you can idle while working on other things and it was honestly a blast collecting all of the dragons. It took me roughly about three and a half ish hours to collect all of the dragons which lines up nicely with the price! The biggest draw for me is just enjoying watching the dragons running about and being absolutely adorable, having such a vast variety really makes it feel like I'm sitting in a meadow where dragons live.

If you're looking for a game where you are constantly doing activities this isn't necessarily that, however I found both the simple mini game of racing and the fishing mechanic to be good time syncs for my personally. 

While I personally did not use the breeding mechanic too much it is pretty cute and straight forward! You place your dragons in the cave and after a couple of minuets you'll end up with a hatchling.

Definitely recommend if you are an enjoyer of idle adjacent games or just want to have cute dragons on your screen while you work on other things (which is what I do personally) Right now, I'm in the process of designing all of my sheds and picking out my favorite little guys to put on display.
